pages.text: 星期一早上，咘咘睁开眼睛，觉得头热热的，身体软软的，一点力气都没有。
pages.text_en: On Monday morning, Bubu opened her eyes and felt her head was hot and her body was weak, with no energy at all.

pages.text: 妈妈轻轻摸了摸咘咘的额头，皱起了眉头：“宝贝，你发烧了。”妈妈把咘咘抱在怀里，温柔地说：“没关系，妈妈在。”
pages.text_en: Mama gently touched Bubu's forehead and frowned: 'Baby, you have a fever.' She held Bubu in her arms and said softly: 'It's okay, Mama is here.'

pages.text: 外婆在厨房熬了一锅暖暖的白粥，还切了小块苹果。外公坐在床边，给咘咘讲小马过河的故事。
pages.text_en: Grandma cooked a warm pot of porridge in the kitchen and cut small apple pieces. Grandpa sat by the bed, telling Bubu the story of the little horse crossing the river.

pages.text: 妈妈带咘咘去了社区小诊所。长颈鹿医生弯下长长的脖子，轻轻地说：“让我看看小兔子哪里不舒服。”
pages.text_en: Mama took Bubu to the community clinic. Dr. Giraffe bent his long neck down and said gently: 'Let me see where the little bunny doesn't feel well.'

pages.text: 护士姐姐说要抽一点点血做检查。咘咘有点害怕，紧紧抓着妈妈的手。但她深吸一口气，闭上眼睛——“我是勇敢的小兔子！”
pages.text_en: The nurse said they needed to take a little blood for tests. Bubu was a bit scared and held Mama's hand tightly. But she took a deep breath and closed her eyes — 'I'm a brave little bunny!'

pages.text: 回到家，妈妈把药倒在小勺子里。药好苦啊！咘咘皱着脸，但还是咕噜一口吞下去了。妈妈赶紧递上一颗甜甜的糖。
pages.text_en: Back home, Mama poured medicine into a little spoon. The medicine was so bitter! Bubu scrunched her face, but still swallowed it in one gulp. Mama quickly handed her a sweet candy.

pages.text: NOMI和NONO守在咘咘身边。NOMI翻开一本故事书，轻声读着；NONO站在枕头边，唱起了温柔的小歌。
pages.text_en: NOMI and NONO stayed by Bubu's side. NOMI opened a storybook and read softly; NONO perched on the pillow, singing a gentle little song.

pages.text: 爸爸从远方打来电话：“咘咘乖，爸爸出差很快就回来。你是最勇敢的小兔子！”咘咘对着手机笑了。
pages.text_en: Papa called from far away: 'Be good Bubu, Papa will be back from his trip soon. You're the bravest little bunny!' Bubu smiled at the phone.

pages.text: 躺在床上的日子，咘咘望着窗外，想念幼儿园的小朋友们。“莫瑜和菲菲在干什么呢？她们会想我吗？”
pages.text_en: Lying in bed, Bubu looked out the window, missing her kindergarten friends. 'What are Moyu and Feifei doing? Do they miss me?'

pages.text: 慢慢地，咘咘的额头不那么烫了。她开始有力气坐起来，还能吃下一整碗外婆的粥了！
pages.text_en: Slowly, Bubu's forehead wasn't so hot anymore. She started having energy to sit up, and could even finish a whole bowl of Grandma's porridge!

pages.text: 星期五早上，咘咘蹦蹦跳跳地回到了幼儿园！莫瑜和菲菲跑过来抱住她：“咘咘回来啦！我们好想你！”
pages.text_en: On Friday morning, Bubu bounced happily back to kindergarten! Moyu and Feifei ran over and hugged her: 'Bubu is back! We missed you so much!'

pages.text: 李老师温柔地摸摸咘咘的头：“欢迎回来，小勇士。”咘咘觉得自己像打了一场小小的仗，赢了！
pages.text_en: Teacher Li gently patted Bubu's head: 'Welcome back, little warrior.' Bubu felt like she had fought a small battle — and won!

pages.text: 晚上，妈妈抱着咘咘，外公外婆坐在旁边，NOMI和NONO趴在被子上。咘咘闭上眼睛想：生病虽然不舒服，但有这么多人爱我，真好呀。
pages.text_en: At night, Mama held Bubu, Grandpa and Grandma sat nearby, NOMI and NONO lay on the blanket. Bubu closed her eyes and thought: Being sick is uncomfortable, but having so many people love me feels so wonderful.
